editProfile.showcaseHint.issue: Awkward phrasing and gender agreement for 'istaknuti' (masculine plural) with 'objave' (feminine plural) and 'sadržaj' (masculine singular). A more idiomatic and concise phrasing for UI is to use 'za isticanje'.
editProfile.showcaseHint.suggested: Izaberi objave i sadržaj za isticanje na vrhu tvog profila.
